notes:
v1.0.38 — CurseForge fix + clearer errors.

Fixed the CurseForge 404: the backend proxy now accepts the exact paths the
launcher sends (/api/cf/mods/search, /mods/:id, /mods/:id/files, changelog,
single file) — previously only shorter browser-test paths matched, so every
launcher request returned HTTP 404. The fix is deployed to the proxy itself,
so CurseForge now works even without updating the launcher; this release also
makes error states honest: the "not connected" setup card only appears when no
proxy URL is configured, while real failures (proxy down / HTTP error) show a
compact Retry banner instead of a misleading setup message.
